verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's homepage describes a zero retention policy under which inputs, outputs and user data stay private, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification. Dedicated private-endpoint instances are offered for data isolation. Because data is not retained by default, it cannot be used for training and no opt-out is needed, though this is inferred rather than stated. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that customer data is never used for model training, detailed policy documentation (scope, exceptions, contractual terms), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
